correctness.rationale: Every odd 2-adic square fills 1+8Z2. For a odd and b even, (au+bu²)-(av+bv²)=(u-v)(a+b(u+v)) has second factor odd; thus the map is an isometry/bijection on each Z/2^k and Z2. Direct expansion of F2(x)=x^4−4x²+2 across valuation classes odd, 2×odd,4×odd, divisible by8 gives exactly the three stated base balls (-1+16Z2), (2+128Z2), (194+512Z2), including full surjectivity. For odd-centre balls f increases exponent one, for centre a≡2 mod8 it increases exponent two; induction yields all r. Factor c_{r+1}−2=(c_r−2)(c_r+2), with v2(c_r+2)=2, establishes v2(c_r−2)=2r+2 and disjointness at precision k>=2r+3. Counts come from full residue-ball reductions including k<=2r+2 overlap, densities from stable exponents, and fixed-point intersection from contracting centres. Independently checked actual SET equality (not just size) for 72 pairs 2<=r<=7, 1<=k<=12; finite checks corroborate but the all-r,k result is the lifting induction.
